selection: Same predetermined contract. Jan1is chosen solely because first day of each month is documented no-key public access, not from option returns; one minute from00UTC preserves initial orderbook snapshot. Jan1is already known underlying-history, not a newly frozen strategy holdout.
representation: Preserve complete HTTP compressed bytes and headers plus decoded exchange-native NDJSON with collector-local timestamps. Independent collector, same underlying exchange; not independent venue, third-party strategy review or proof of execution/whole lifecycle.
